ppo = copy.deepcopy(reference).requires_grad_(True)
    dpo = copy.deepcopy(reference).requires_grad_(True)
    ppo_initial_hash, dpo_initial_hash = _state_sha256(ppo), _state_sha256(dpo)
    value = FiniteValueModel().to(ctx.device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(ppo.parameters(), lr=CONFIG["ppo_learning_rate"])
    value_optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(value.parameters(), lr=CONFIG["value_learning_rate"])
    action_generator = torch.Generator(device=ctx.device).manual_seed(ctx.seed + 2)
    ppo_history, first_rollout = [], []
    stage_started = time.perf_counter()
    for rollout in range(CONFIG["ppo_rollout_batches"]):
        indices = torch.tensor(sampler.choices(range(len(train)), k=CONFIG["ppo_rollout_size"]), device=ctx.device)
        features = x[indices]
        with torch.no_grad():
            old_log_probs = ppo(features).log_softmax(-1)
            actions = torch.multinomial(old_log_probs.exp(), 1, generator=action_generator).squeeze(1)
            old_selected = old_log_probs.gather(1, actions[:, None]).squeeze(1).clone()
            old_values = value(features).clone()
            rewards = _normalized_scores(reward_model(features), scale).gather(1, actions[:, None]).squeeze(1)
            advantages = bandit_advantage(rewards, old_values)
            reference_logits = reference(features)
        fixed_old_hash = hashlib.sha256(old_selected.numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest()
        for epoch in range(CONFIG["ppo_epochs_per_rollout"]):
            logits = ppo(features)
            selected = logits.log_softmax(-1).gather(1, actions[:, None]).squeeze(1)
            terms = ppo_clipped_objective(selected, old_selected, advantages, CONFIG["ppo_clip_range"])
            kl = exact_kl(logits, reference_logits).mean()
            policy_loss = terms["policy_loss"] + CONFIG["reference_kl_coefficient"] * kl
            _update(optimizer, ppo.parameters(), policy_loss)
            value_loss = F.mse_loss(value(features), rewards)
            _update(value_optimizer, value.parameters(), value_loss)
